items: AI emits short Kethic instead of repeating full HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Tailwind classes.
Design identity is generated once and reused across pages instead of being re-written every time.
Repeated UI like features, proof cards, FAQs, and pricing can render from reusable data rows.
Content can live in JSON, user docs, or CMS exports while page source stays focused on structure.
Sections carry small role hints like hero, features, proof, and CTA so the compiler can choose better defaults.
Kethic still compiles to ordinary HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that can be hosted anywhere.
